thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning to run the 'profile_attrs' schema migration tomorrow 03:00 UTC. This is a small additive column + backfill, but we'll do a dual-write for 1 hour starting at 03:00 to ensure no surprises.

alex: Who's owning the deploy window and smoke checks? I can be on call for the first 30m but need someone to own rollback readiness.

maria: I can take deploy owner for the window. I'll be online from 02:45–04:00 UTC.

jon: I can handle smoke validation — will run the post-deploy sanity script and check reads/writes on the dual-write path. Ping me when the migration completes.

alex: Thanks — Maria, can you also ensure metrics dashboard is pinned and we have alerts for replication lag > 5s and consumer error rate spike?

maria: Yep. I'll pin the dashboard and add a quick temporary alert with a 2min evaluation.

jon: Smoke checklist I'll run after migration finishes: 
```bash
# sanity checks
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/profiles -d '{"name":"smoke-test"}' | jq .
curl -sS https://api.redwood.dev/v1/profiles/smoke-test | jq .
# compare write path vs dual-write mirror count
SELECT count(*) FROM profiles WHERE name = 'smoke-test';
```

alex: Good. A few operational notes: 
- We'll use low-concurrency backfill (batch_size=1000) to avoid DB bursts.
- If lag > 10s for >5min, we abort and roll back dual-write.
- Rollback procedure: flip feature-flag off, stop backfill job, and run compensating sync job to revert partial rows.

maria: Can we also feature-flag the new column at the app level? I want to avoid any runtime NPEs.

alex: Yes feature flag in staging is already on. We'll flip in prod once migration finishes. App PR is merged — @deploy-bot will run the deploy once we give the go.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for alex/maria window at 03:00 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm readiness.

tess: Quick question — do we need to quiesce any downstream consumers before we start dual-write? There are a couple of analytics consumers that assume schema shape.

jon: Good call. I'll coordinate with data-eng to pause the downstream job for the 03:00–04:00 window.

maria: Confirmed. Downstream consumers paused at 02:55 UTC.

alex: Final checklist before we start: 
- [ ] deploy owner (maria) online (yes)
- [ ] smoke owner (jon) online (yes)
- [ ] dashboard + alerts (maria) (yes)
- [ ] downstream paused (jon + data-eng) (yes)
- [ ] rollback docs pinned in ops-runbooks (alex) (yes)

maria: All green from my side. Reacted with :white_check_mark:.

jon: Ready. I'll post smoke results here once done.

alex: Perfect — I'll kick off at 03:00 and update the thread at each stage. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
